features.summary: Firefox’s layout and testing tools now preserve window names as UTF-16, avoiding needless text conversion and potential loss of characters. Several internal actors were migrated to the `moz-src` format, and obsolete layout-tool service references were removed.

features.label: Style inspector APIs

patches.author: Jonathan Kew
patches.subject: Merge the gfxFontVariationValue type with gfxFontVariation (= mozilla::gfx::FontVariation).

patches.author: Nicolas Chevobbe
patches.subject: Handle substitution functions in InspectorUtils.getComputationSteps.

features.summary: Developer-facing Style Inspector APIs now use a unified font-variation type, making variable-font information more consistent across the graphics and inspection layers. `InspectorUtils.getComputationSteps` also understands CSS substitution functions, so DevTools can better explain how final computed styles are produced.

features.label: Docs

patches.author: Manuel Bucher
patches.subject: Fix broken inter-doc links from bug 2038819

features.summary: Firefox’s documentation links were corrected so references between documents resolve properly after the documentation changes associated with bug 2038819. _This is a documentation-only fix with no intended browser behavior change._

features.label: MathML

patches.author: Benjamin Peterson
patches.subject: Remove stray layout/mathml/output.txt.

features.summary: An obsolete stray output file was removed from the MathML layout tests. _There is no user-visible behavior change; this keeps the test area clean and avoids retaining generated artifacts._

features.label: Media IPC

patches.author: Hiroyuki Ikezoe
patches.subject: Track each pipeline's embedder LayersId in CompositorBridgeParent::LayerTreeState.

features.summary: Media IPC now records the compositor `LayersId` associated with each media pipeline’s embedder. This gives Firefox’s media and graphics processes the tracking information needed to associate video layers with the correct compositor tree, improving reliability for rendered media.

features.label: Printing & print preview

patches.author: Emilio Cobos Álvarez
patches.subject: Only return a container frame top level docs during print preview.

features.summary: Print Preview now focuses on the document’s top-level container frame instead of returning nested frame documents. This makes print rendering more predictable for pages built with embedded content, while _not changing the visible printing workflow for most users_.

features.label: Table layout

patches.author: Alexander Gankov
patches.subject: Fix collapsed border painting on continuation pages.

features.summary: Printing tables with collapsed borders now paints those borders correctly when a table continues onto another page, improving the visual consistency of paginated documents.
